name: Bioderma Sebium

card.summary: A French pharmacy skincare line for oily, blemish-prone skin, including cleansers and micellar water meant to keep skin clearer.

quick.overview:
Sebium is a range from Bioderma, a French dermatology company, aimed at oily and acne-prone skin. Its best-known item is Sebium H2O micellar solution, used to cleanse and remove makeup.

What clearer skin does for appearance is the goal: fewer visible blemishes. Sebium H2O appeared as the topical control treatment in a 180-patient acne trial, where light-based devices outperformed it.
quick.how: Users apply the cleanser or micellar water as part of a daily routine for oily skin. It is typically one step alongside other acne products.
quick.risks: Cosmetic skincare of this type is generally low-risk; individual skin reactions are possible.

lead: Sebium is a line of skincare products from Bioderma, a French pharmaceutical company founded in 1977 by Jean-Noel Thorel and based in Aix-en-Provence.[1] The line targets oily, acne-prone skin.

The Sebium H2O Micellaire Solution was used as the topical control in a randomized trial of 180 patients with mild to moderate acne, in which IPL-based treatments reduced papules, pustules and comedones more than the control.[2]

angle.text: Sebium products are used as a daily cleansing step for blemish-prone skin.

paras: Bioderma is a privately owned French dermatology company; Sebium is one of its product names.[1]

A randomized investigator-blind trial compared vacuum plus IPL, IPL alone, and a control group treated topically with Sebium H2O Micellaire Solution in 180 patients; both device groups showed significant reductions in lesions versus the control.[2] The trial did not evaluate Sebium on its own as the intervention.
